thread:
Alex P.: Quick sync on v2 migration smoke checks — short list of outstanding items before we start canary. TL;DR: SDK PRs mostly ready, runtime KV/layout thing causing 500s for some embed requests, one flaky e2e test, and infra needs to provision canary capacity. Owners: @Maria G. (SDK), @Drew H. (runtime), @Jamie L. (infra). Please ack or reassign.

Maria G.: Ack. SDK PR #4321 is in review — 2 small comments from QA. I can push fixes today. Also saw the JS client changed default param name (temp -> temperature) — adding a compat shim so old clients don't break.

Drew H.: We're seeing a KV cache layout mismatch for quantized models >8B. Repro (local):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v2/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-8b-q4", "input":"test"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Response: 500 + "kv_layout_mismatch" in logs. Root cause looks like an earlier change to KV packing order. Working on a patch (runtime PR 4412), aim to revert packing delta to restore compatibility. ETA: EOD CET.

Jamie L.: Provision request created: #req-789 (2x g5.2xlarge canary nodes). @deploy-bot will hold until we have green smoke. ETA ~3h. I also added a routing override rule to send 5% traffic to canary when toggled.

Alex P.: Canary rollout window: Wed 03:00-07:00 UTC. If infra can't hit 2x capacity, we'll stagger instead. Also: deprecation timeline question — current target: v1 deprecate 2026-05-01, but we can extend to 2026-06-01 for large customers if Migration PM requests it. Maria, can you notify the bigger customers of the compat shim?

Maria G.: Yes, will draft an email and post a note to #customer-success. Also will add a migration note in CHANGELOG for the JS/py SDKs.

Drew H.: CI note: tests/compat/test_embed_integration.py::test_cache_invalidate is flaky (7/50 failures). I suspect race on cache warmup between worker threads. Reverting the async-prefetch tweak in PR 4412 to test stability.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary-tier toggle = OFF -> awaiting manual trigger. Link: https://deploys.internal/reQ/789

Jamie L.: Once Drew's runtime patch lands, I can trigger a canary deploy and run the smoke script:

```
./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --model redwood-8b-q4 --requests 50
```

ops-bot: NOTE: There will be a short latency bump during canary ramp (roughly +10-20ms p50) — alerting on p95 > 400ms.

Alex P.: Action items:
- Maria: land SDK fixes + publish compat patch (today).
- Drew: push runtime revert PR and link CI (EOD).
- Jamie: confirm canary nodes ready and run smoke after runtime patch (3h ETA).
- @all: review and approve PRs if you are listed as reviewer.

Please reply with ack or if you need me to reassign ownership. :thumbsup:

Maria G.: Ack, working on SDK fixes now.

Drew H.: Ack, will post PR link when ready.

Jamie L.: Ack, will ping when nodes are up and smoke completes.

Alex P.: Perfect — I'll coordinate the timing and post a brief runbook for rollback steps before we flip the canary.
